property_summary: For any account and token id, balanceOf either reverts (if account is zero) or returns a non-negative value; the bug makes balanceOf return a value for account=0 instead of reverting, changing revert to success.
change_summary: Remove the require check that account is not the zero address, so balanceOf(address(0), id) returns the token balance stored under address(0) instead of reverting.
